metadata.title: In a wild October for markets, these stocks were the biggest winners and losers - MarketWatch

content.text:
Deep Dive
In a wild October for markets, these stocks were the biggest winners and losers
Many Big Tech stocks were hit hard but the S&P 500 showed strength under the surface, with a majority of stocks showing gains for the month
October brought a lot of carnage in tech stocks, but you might not guess that from the S&P 500’s performance.
The S&P 500 SPX declined 0.9% for October, even though 72% of stocks in the large-cap benchmark index were up for the month.
